# GAAP Spices & Super Food

> Premium Indian spices and superfoods, exported globally.

## About Us
GAAP Spices & Super Food LLP is a certified Indian exporter of premium quality spices and superfoods. We bridge the gap between local Indian farmers and the global market, ensuring fair trade and sustainable practices.

## Products
We specialize in high-quality, export-grade products:

### Turmeric
- Turmeric Fingers (Medium & High Curcumin)
- Turmeric Flakes
- Turmeric Powder
- Value-added turmeric products

### Moringa
- Moringa Oleifera Leaf Powder (Nutrient-dense superfood)

### Other Spices
- Red Chilli (Whole & Powder)
- Black Pepper
- Green Cardamom
- Black Cardamom

## Certifications & Quality
- **Spices Board of India Registered** - Export license holder
- **FSSAI Registered** - Food Safety and Standards Authority of India compliant
- **Organic Compliant** - Zero pesticide residue, tested by NABL accredited labs

## Mission
To deliver authentic Indian flavors worldwide while maintaining the highest standards of quality and purity, bridging the gap between local farming traditions and the global culinary market.
